summary: The camel caravan heading for Egypt carries this aromatic along with spices and balm. Jacob later includes the same product in a gift of the best produce of the land.

senses.definition: Both occurrences name it among fragrant goods traded or given away. Neither passage identifies the plant.

note: The noun lacks the consonants of לחש, under which it is indexed by page order. Identification as the resin of a rockrose remains uncertain.
